name: velura-zoho-mail
description: Read, search, send and organise Zoho Mail from Claude through a local MCP server that talks to the Zoho Mail REST API.

client_id.title: Zoho client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your Zoho self client, created at api-console.zoho.com (use your data center's domain)

client_secret.title: Zoho client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the same Zoho self client

refresh_token.title: Zoho refresh token
refresh_token.description: Refresh token granted with scopes ZohoMail.messages.ALL, ZohoMail.accounts.READ and ZohoMail.folders.READ

data_center.title: Zoho data center
data_center.description: Domain suffix of your Zoho account: com (US), in (India), eu, com.au, jp, sa or ca

account_id.title: Mail account ID (optional)
account_id.description: Leave empty to use your default Zoho Mail account

from_address.title: Default sender address (optional)
from_address.description: Leave empty to send from the account's primary address

allow_permanent_delete.title: Allow permanent delete
allow_permanent_delete.description: When off, deleting an email always moves it to Trash
